body.x: BMT, participated ‘2017 Korea Electronics Show(KES)’ held at COEX in Samseong-dong from October 17th (Tue) to 20th (Fri) and introduced ‘Total solutions such as electric, EMS, and others.

Deputy director Hwang Jung-Gwi of BMT said, “BMT is the total solution company for such as, electricity, EMS and others”, and added, “We provide the solutions that enables to monitor and analyze MES, New and Renewable Energy for the preparation of the 4 th industrial revolution”. Along with it, he said, “By analyzing the power, we will do analyze on energy, production principle management, and it is possible to do effective operation of the New and Renewable energy”.

Meanwhile, KES 2017, hosted by Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Energy and sponsored by KEA (Korea Electronics Association), is an international show where lots of potential buyers, governments, group officials participate, providing a good place to experience world first products like mobile phone, semiconductor, display, and next generation convergence solutions like industrial convergence, IT convergence, digital broadcasting, smart education and e health.
